newsitem.title: USA: Community Care names Burdi as COO.
newsitem.headline: Community Care names Burdi as COO.

text.p: Community Care Services Inc said it appointed Saverio Burdi as Chief Operating Officer.
Burdi succeeds Allan Goldfeder whose term as COO was terminated by the board on July 2 after Goldfeder became the target of a federal criminal investigation.
Burdi joined Community Care in the May 1997 acquisition of Metropolitan Respirator Service where he served as a partner and vice president in charge of sales and marketing.
Community Care provides home health care products and services, medical equipment and disposable medical supplies.
